why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Check you're eligible. Ondo Perps and Ondo Points exclude the US, Panama and other prohibited jurisdictions.
Sign in at app.ondoperps.xyz with email or a wallet such as MetaMask, Phantom or Coinbase Wallet.
Send USDC on Ethereum or Arbitrum, or eligible tokenized stocks on Ethereum, to your account's deposit address.
Trade perps. Your balance appears on the points page after each weekly drop.
costs: A promotion halves perp fees to 0.01% for makers and 0.025% for takers, from 0.02% and 0.05%. The docs don't say when it ends. Liquidations cost 1.5% of the position's value, and USDC withdrawals may carry a fee. The Ondo Perps docs page on fees on 18 October 2026, showing promotional rates of 0.01% for makers and 0.025% for takers. Source: Ondo Perps docs Warning A leveraged position can lose you
risks: The site's eligibility terms exclude the US, Panama, Canada and sanctioned jurisdictions. Beta limits can change, including the position cap and per-asset caps on stock collateral.
